messages:
Ravi (Marketing): Quick design brief for next week's webinar promo + benchmark card pack. Need a small batch of assets by Wed AM so events can schedule posts. Priorities: 1) 3 'snapshot' one-column cards (600x800) each highlighting one metric: p95 latency, cost per 1k, and throughput. 2) A compact 2-page PDF 'snapshot kit' for sales (A5) with small comparison table. 3) 1 hero banner for the registration page (1400x500). Keep visuals very brand-forward and minimal.

Ivy (Design): Sounds good. Questions: should the three cards be visually consistent or each use an illustration? Also do we have approved copy for the cards?

Ravi (Marketing): Consistent layout, but small distinct color accent per metric (primary palette only). Copy will be micro: headline (6-8 words) + 1-line explainer (12-16 words). I'll paste final copy later today.

MetricsBot: Data snapshot (auto):
model,config,p95_ms,throughput_tps,cost_per_1k_usd
redwood-7b,default,60,210,0.011
redwood-14b,quant,95,130,0.017
open-7b,default,140,95,0.010
(Full sheet uploaded to marketing-drive /benchmark-snapshots.csv)

Ivy (Design): Thanks. For the table in the A5 kit, do we need to show confidence intervals or just point estimates? Also export specs?

Noah (Brand): Export: PDF (print-ready, 300dpi) + PNG web 72dpi. Use single-line logo for web banner, stacked lockup for A5. No alternate palettes. Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for small text. Provide alt text for every image.

Ally (Events): FYI: Webinar registration page prefers hero banner as jpg with <200KB. Can you provide a 2x retina png as well for the confirmation email?

Ivy (Design): Noted. I'll do a small type scale (H1,H2,body) mapping and deliverables: PNGs for each card, A5 PDF, hero JPG + @2x PNG. ETA: Tue EOD for first pass.

Ravi (Marketing): Super. Also need a short methodology blurb for the A5 (18-25 words). Example: "Benchmarks measured on production-like traffic with consistent payloads; costs normalized per 1k tokens." I'll refine.

MetricsBot: Note: when rendering sparkline for cost, use cost_per_1k_usd series across model sizes. Sample JSON below: ```{"series":[{"name":"cost","points":[0.011,0.017,0.010],"labels":["7b","14b","open-7b"]}]}```

Ivy (Design): Good. Any required badges? We have 'Redwood verified' and 'Tested on infra' badges available.

Noah (Brand): Use only 'Redwood verified' badge. Link: https://assets.brand/verified.svg. Make badge 24px inside cards.

Ravi (Marketing): Also add a tiny CTA on each card: "Learn more" with a short URL. Sales team wants UTM-friendly placeholder.

Ally (Events): Reminder: cards should be localized-ready. Leave copy fields in Figma as text layers (not flattened). We'll localize to EN/DE/FR next week.

Ivy (Design): Will keep editable layers and comment with export names. Will also include a layer for alt text metadata.

Ravi (Marketing): Thanks team. @Ivy once you drop first pass, I'll run copy edits and return notes by Wed AM. :sparkles:

Ivy (Design): On it 449
